title.zh-TW: 新增 /copy btw 複製旁支回答全文，打指令附帶參數幽靈提示
title.en: Add /copy btw to copy full text of side-question responses, with argument ghost hints when typing commands

body.zh-TW: 一邊等待 AI 處理主要工作，一邊透過 `/btw` 提出旁支問題，取用解答文字現在更加俐落。⟦這好比在研討會聽講時，你在桌角備忘便條隨手記下專家的延伸解答；即使便條紙正巧被厚重講義遮住或摺疊收攏，專屬助理也能替你將整張便條的文字原樣複印到筆記夾中。⟧當你交代助理撰寫長篇企劃，趁空檔用 `/btw` 查詢專有名詞，讀完後想把整段答覆貼進工作報告，這正是輸入 `/copy btw` 的時刻。這項新增的斜線子指令，能將當前進行中的 `/btw` 旁支回答全文直接複製至剪貼簿，就算回覆卡片已經收合或被捲動移出可見畫面，也完全不影響複製。此外，當你在終端機鍵入 `/copy` 時，指令輸入列還會顯示參數的幽靈提示（輸入指令時以淡色顯示的待填參數建議），提醒你能接續輸入哪些可用選項。
body.en: While waiting for AI to handle primary tasks, asking side questions via `/btw` and retrieving the answer text is now much smoother. ⟦This is like attending a conference lecture and jotting down an expert's elaboration on a sticky note at the corner of your desk; even if the note happens to be covered by heavy handouts or folded away, your dedicated assistant can still copy the exact text from the entire note into your binder for you.⟧ When you ask an assistant to draft a long-form proposal and use `/btw` during downtime to look up technical terms, and then want to paste the full answer into your report after reading, this is the exact moment to type `/copy btw`. This newly added slash subcommand copies the full text of the active `/btw` side-question response directly to your clipboard, even if the response card is collapsed or scrolled out of view. In addition, when you type `/copy` in the terminal, the command input bar displays argument ghost hints (faded suggestions for parameters to fill in while typing commands) to remind you of available options you can enter next.

items.original: Added the `/copy btw` slash subcommand to copy the full text of the active `/btw` side-question response to the clipboard even when the response card is collapsed or scrolled, along with argument ghost hints when typing `/copy`.

title.zh-TW: 工具選用約束轉為原生後端設定，提升呼叫忠實度
title.en: Translate tool-choice constraints into native backend configurations to improve calling fidelity

body.zh-TW: 指揮 AI 配合特定流程呼叫工具時，模型遵循呼叫限制的表現現在更加精準可靠。以前在每次請求中指定工具選用約束，例如限制必須呼叫任意工具的 `any`、強制調用工具的 `required`，或是指定特定具名函式，若未深入底層，執行時偶爾仍可能偏離指示。現在系統會將每筆請求的工具選用約束，直接轉換為後端原生的函式呼叫設定（由模型服務底層介面直接控管工具挑選的機制），確保工具呼叫的保真度徹底落實。⟦恰似精密物流中心的分揀輸送帶，當包裹貼上「必須檢驗」或指定特定通道的標籤時，系統直接將分流指令寫入輸送帶底層的感應電路，包裹自然順著軌道精準送達，不再有任何錯漏。⟧
body.en: When directing AI to call tools for specific workflows, the model's adherence to calling restrictions is now more precise and reliable. Previously, when specifying per-request tool-choice constraints—such as `any` requiring calling any tool, `required` enforcing tool invocation, or specifying named functions—executions could still occasionally deviate from instructions if not integrated into the underlying layer. Now, the system directly translates per-request tool-choice constraints into native backend function-calling configurations (a mechanism where the model service's underlying interface directly manages tool selection), ensuring complete fidelity in tool calling. ⟦Just like a sorting conveyor belt in a precision logistics center, when a package is labeled 'must inspect' or assigned a specific lane, the system writes routing instructions directly into the conveyor's underlying sensor circuits, allowing packages to arrive precisely along the track without errors.⟧

items.original: Improved tool-calling fidelity by translating per-request tool-choice constraints (`any`, `required`, and named functions) into native backend function-calling configurations.

title.zh-TW: /hooks 與檢查工具納入已啟用外掛隨附的掛鉤設定
title.en: Include hook configurations bundled inside enabled plugins in /hooks and inspection utilities

body.zh-TW: 檢查自動化流程的掛鉤設定時，外掛隨附的規則不再無端隱形。以前在終端機執行 `/hooks` 指令或使用掛鉤檢查工具列出使用中的 `hooks.json` 設定時，系統會漏掉已啟用外掛套件裡自帶的 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），導致你難以確認外掛功能是否如期攔截；這個遺漏問題現在已經修好，清單會如實列出已啟用外掛隨附的所有掛鉤設定。
body.en: When inspecting hook configurations in automated workflows, rules bundled with plugins no longer invisibly disappear. Previously, when running the `/hooks` command in the terminal or using hook inspection utilities to list active `hooks.json` configurations, the system omitted hooks bundled inside enabled plugin packages (small programs triggered when specific events occur), making it difficult to verify whether plugin features were intercepting as expected. This omission issue is now fixed, and listings faithfully include all hook configurations bundled with enabled plugins.

items.original: Fixed the `/hooks` command and hook inspection utilities omitting hooks bundled inside enabled plugins when listing active `hooks.json` configurations.

title.zh-TW: 自訂子代理繼承父代理 MCP 伺服器，並正確解析相對設定路徑
title.en: Custom subagents inherit parent MCP servers and correctly resolve relative configuration paths

body.zh-TW: 配置專門分工的自訂子代理時，工具連線與檔案路徑的兩項問題已獲修正。以前在建立自訂子代理時就算指定了 `enable_mcp_tools: true`，子代理也只會收到一份空的伺服器清單，無法順利繼承父代理原先設定妥當的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器；同時，宣告式子代理設定若使用 `relative_path_to_config` 指定相對設定檔路徑，系統也無法以父代理所在的目錄為基準完成解析。這兩項路徑與設定繼承問題現在都已經修好，子代理會確實繼承父代理的外部工具伺服器，相對路徑也能順利對齊。
body.en: When configuring custom subagents for specialized division of labor, two issues with tool connections and file paths have been fixed. Previously, even if `enable_mcp_tools: true` was specified when creating a custom subagent, the subagent only received an empty server list and failed to inherit the configured MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol allowing AI to connect to external tools) servers from the parent agent. At the same time, if a declarative subagent configuration specified a relative configuration file path using `relative_path_to_config`, the system failed to resolve it against the parent agent's directory. Both path and configuration inheritance issues are now fixed, ensuring subagents properly inherit the parent agent's external tool servers and relative paths align smoothly.

items.original: Fixed custom subagents created with `enable_mcp_tools: true` receiving an empty MCP server list instead of inheriting the parent agent's configured MCP servers, and fixed declarative subagent configurations failing to resolve relative config file paths (`relative_path_to_config`) against the parent agent's directory.

title.zh-TW: 主動回饋提示不再過早跳出，排除初期對話與暫態錯誤干擾
title.en: Proactive feedback prompts no longer trigger prematurely, eliminating early-session and transient-error disruptions

body.zh-TW: 在終端機展開新對話或使用工具時，評分詢問不再無端跳出打擾節奏。以前只要工作階段剛開始的前幾輪對話、或者工具遇到短暫發生但隨後已順利復原的暫態錯誤，系統的主動回饋提示就會過早觸發，在任務尚未明朗時突然向你索取意見；這個過早觸發的問題現在已經修好，不會再在對話初期或暫態錯誤復原時過早彈出提示打斷思路。
body.en: When starting a new conversation in the terminal or using tools, feedback rating prompts no longer pop up unexpectedly to disrupt your flow. Previously, during the first few turns of a session or when tools encountered transient errors that quickly recovered, proactive feedback prompts triggered prematurely, soliciting feedback before tasks were clear. This premature triggering issue is now fixed, preventing pop-up prompts from interrupting your train of thought during early conversations or recovered transient errors.

items.original: Fixed proactive feedback prompts triggering prematurely during the first few turns of a session or on transient, recovered tool errors.

entries: Improved the startup warning for deprecated `unsandboxed` permission rules across CLI, shared, and project configuration files to list each affected file path, up to five offending rules, and step-by-step instructions for migrating them to `command` rules.
Improved `/resume` startup responsiveness when opening a large conversation history with a cold or stale summary cache.

Fixed MCP servers bundled inside plugins colliding with each other or with user-configured servers in `mcp_config.json` when they shared the same server name by automatically namespacing plugin MCP servers as `<plugin>_<server>`.

Fixed a memory leak where opening or scanning conversations left background step-cache eviction goroutines running for the rest of the session, significantly reducing memory usage after opening `/resume` or switching conversations.

Fixed `view_file` attempting to parse non-UTF-8 binary files as text or loading files larger than 100 MB into the model context; unsupported binary formats and oversized files are now rejected with a clear error before overflowing the context window.
Fixed Gemini API (`GEMINI_API_KEY`) sessions dropping model thinking blocks from prior turns on subsequent user messages and failing to propagate thought signatures on text and thought parts.

Fixed artifact review failing to trigger when a directory name above `.gemini/` matched a skipped path component such as `scratch`, prevented conversation forks and snapshot reverts from copying internal `.system_generated/subagents` and `.system_generated/worktrees` directories, and cleaned up subagent metadata records when deleting a conversation.
Fixed deleted conversations being recreated as empty, schema-less SQLite database files when background queries reconnected after deletion.
Fixed conversations launched without a workspace folder inheriting workspace paths and customizations from other open sessions.

title.zh-TW: `unsandboxed` 權限棄用警告升級，列出檔案路徑、五條違規規則與 `command` 遷移步驟
title.en: Upgraded Deprecation Warning for `unsandboxed` Permissions Lists File Paths, Five Offending Rules, and `command` Migration Steps

body.zh-TW: 管理專案安全防護有了更清楚的指引。舊版廢棄規則的啟動警告現在能精準指出問題所在。⟦宛如大樓消防安檢人員巡檢後開立改善通知單，不僅逐一標出違規的樓層門牌，更明確列出最多五處不合規的排煙閥位置，並附上標準更換步驟。⟧以前若在命令列全域、共用或個別專案設定檔中殘留了舊版的 `unsandboxed` 權限規則，啟動警告往往讓人找不著頭緒。現在啟動提示全面改善，會逐一列出每個受影響的設定檔完整路徑，直接列出最多五條違規規則，並附上逐步遷移指引，帶領你將它們改寫為新版的 `command` 規則，維護工作一目了然。
body.en: Managing project security protections is now guided by clearer instructions. Startup warnings for deprecated legacy rules now pinpoint exactly where the issues lie. ⟦Much like a building fire safety inspector issuing a correction notice that not only marks the offending floor room numbers one by one, but also specifically lists up to five non-compliant smoke damper locations and attaches standard replacement steps.⟧ In the past, leaving legacy `unsandboxed` permission rules in CLI global, shared, or individual project configuration files often resulted in confusing startup warnings. Now, the startup warning has been thoroughly improved to list the full path of each affected configuration file, explicitly display up to five offending rules, and provide step-by-step migration instructions to guide you through rewriting them into new `command` rules, making maintenance crystal clear.

items.original: Improved the startup warning for deprecated `unsandboxed` permission rules across CLI, shared, and project configuration files to list each affected file path, up to five offending rules, and step-by-step instructions for migrating them to `command` rules.

title.zh-TW: `/resume` 啟動反應加速，冷快取與過期摘要快速載入長篇對話
title.en: `/resume` Startup Responsiveness Accelerated, Fast Loading for Long Conversations with Cold Caches and Stale Summaries

body.zh-TW: 接續先前討論過的大型長篇任務，恢復對話的載入反應現在敏捷許多。⟦好似老航海船長翻開厚實的航行日誌，就算前段航程的彙整摘要尚未預先抄錄、或是前次留下的備忘筆記早已過期，也能立刻翻至指定頁面接續記錄，不再被卡在漫長的翻查等待中。⟧以前在終端機輸入 `/resume` 指令嘗試開啟對話紀錄特別龐大的歷史時，只要摘要快取（把對話內容預先暫存起來以加速讀取的機制）處於尚未預熱的冷啟動狀態、或者快取內容已經過期，啟動過程往往會出現明顯的停頓延遲。現在這項啟動反應速度已獲得改善，即使面對快取尚未就緒或內容過期的長篇歷史紀錄，也能迅速完成載入並恢復對話。
body.en: Resuming large, extended tasks from previous discussions is now significantly more responsive. ⟦Like an experienced sea captain opening a thick logbook who can immediately turn to the target page and continue recording without getting stuck in a long search, even if the summary of the previous voyage has not been prepared yet or the previous memo notes have long expired.⟧ Previously, when running the `/resume` command in the terminal to open an exceptionally large conversation history, noticeable delays would occur whenever the summary cache (a mechanism that temporarily stores conversation content in advance to speed up reading) was cold or stale. This startup responsiveness has now been improved, allowing the system to quickly complete loading and resume conversations even with unready or expired caches over long conversation histories.

items.original: Improved `/resume` startup responsiveness when opening a large conversation history with a cold or stale summary cache.

title.zh-TW: 外掛隨附 MCP 伺服器自動套用命名空間，徹底防範重名衝突
title.en: Plugin-Bundled MCP Servers Automatically Namespaced to Prevent Name Collisions

body.zh-TW: 為終端機擴充各式外部工具，外掛隨附的伺服器重名衝突現在迎刃而解。當你使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）時，不同外掛套件隨附的伺服器，過去若恰好取了相同的名稱，彼此之間、或是與你在 `mcp_config.json` 中自訂的伺服器便會發生衝突與覆蓋。這種命名撞車會導致其中一方無法正常運作。現在系統會自動替外掛隨附的伺服器加上命名空間，統一改以 `<plugin>_<server>` 的格式獨立註冊，徹底解決重名互相覆蓋的問題。⟦恰如大型聯合辦公室替各進駐團隊編發專屬分機號碼，在內部總機名稱前自動加上團隊代號，就算不同團隊都恰巧指派了一位「總務」，各分機撥通時也絕不互相佔線或搶撥。⟧
body.en: When extending the terminal with various external tools, name collisions among plugin-bundled servers are now completely resolved. When using MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools), bundled servers across different plugins that happened to share the same name previously collided with each other or overwrote custom servers in your `mcp_config.json`. Such naming clashes would prevent one of the servers from working properly. The system now automatically namespaces plugin-bundled servers, registering them independently in the `<plugin>_<server>` format to eliminate overlapping naming conflicts. ⟦Just like a large coworking space assigning dedicated extension numbers to each resident team by prefixing team codes to internal directory names, ensuring that even if multiple teams each appoint a "general affairs" lead, calls to different extensions never interfere with or intercept each other.⟧

items.original: Fixed MCP servers bundled inside plugins colliding with each other or with user-configured servers in `mcp_config.json` when they shared the same server name by automatically namespacing plugin MCP servers as `<plugin>_<server>`.

title.zh-TW: 開啟或切換對話修復背景協程洩漏，顯著降低記憶體佔用
title.en: Opening or Switching Conversations Fixes Background Goroutine Leak, Significantly Reducing Memory Usage

body.zh-TW: 頻繁開啟歷史對話或在任務間切換，終端機不再悄悄囤積過多電腦記憶體。⟦彷彿房務人員走進客房整理床單後，卻忘記關閉浴室抽風機與走廊照明，讓馬達在無人使用的空房中持續空轉耗電，如今退房流程落實了隨手關閉機制，房間巡檢完畢便即刻切斷閒置電器。⟧以前只要在命令列開啟或掃描對話紀錄，背景負責清理步驟快取（用來暫存各執行步驟紀錄的內部機制）的背景協程常會殘留下來，並在整個工作階段中持續運行，造成不必要的記憶體流失。這個記憶體流失問題現在已經修好，執行 `/resume` 重新載入對話或在不同對話間頻繁切換後，系統記憶體佔用顯著減少，長久運作依然維持輕快。
body.en: When frequently opening conversation histories or switching between tasks, the terminal no longer silently accumulates excessive system memory. ⟦Much like housekeeping staff making beds in a guest room but forgetting to turn off the bathroom exhaust fan and hallway lights, leaving motors idling and consuming electricity in an empty room, whereas the check-out process now enforces a shutdown protocol to immediately cut power to idle appliances after room inspection.⟧ Previously, whenever conversation histories were opened or scanned from the command line, background goroutines responsible for evicting step cache (an internal mechanism for temporarily caching execution step records) often lingered and ran throughout the rest of the session, causing unnecessary memory leaks. This memory leak has now been fixed, significantly reducing system memory usage after running `/resume` or switching between conversations, keeping long-running sessions nimble and responsive.

items.original: Fixed a memory leak where opening or scanning conversations left background step-cache eviction goroutines running for the rest of the session, significantly reducing memory usage after opening `/resume` or switching conversations.

title.zh-TW: `view_file` 拒絕非 UTF-8 二進位檔與 100 MB 超大檔，防止上下文塞爆
title.en: `view_file` Rejects Non-UTF-8 Binary Files and 100 MB Oversized Files to Prevent Context Overflow

body.zh-TW: 把檔案交給 AI 閱讀時，工具現在能主動擋下會塞爆上下文視窗的非預期輸入。以前使用 `view_file` 工具查看檔案時，若遇上非 UTF-8 編碼的二進位檔案，往往會硬當成純文字解析；甚至在碰上體積大於 100 MB 的超大檔案時，也會直接嘗試塞進模型的上下文視窗（模型在單一輪對話中所能讀取與容納的文字容量上限）。這種過度載入常導致對話中斷或發生錯誤。現在這項缺陷已經修好，面對不支援的二進位格式與超大檔案，工具會在讀取前直接予以拒絕並回傳明確錯誤，避免塞爆模型上下文視窗。⟦好比自動文件掃描機的進紙托盤，遇到未支援的透明塑膠板、或是厚度超過一百頁的厚重硬皮書時，會在入紙口主動退件並亮起清楚的錯誤警示，絕不硬塞進滾輪以防卡紙扯壞內部機件。⟧
body.en: When handing files over for AI reading, the tool now actively intercepts unexpected inputs that would overflow the context window. Previously, when using `view_file` to inspect files, non-UTF-8 encoded binary files were often forcibly parsed as plain text, and files larger than 100 MB were directly loaded into the model's context window (the upper limit of text capacity that the model can ingest and hold in a single turn). Such overloading frequently led to conversation aborts or errors. This defect is now fixed; unsupported binary formats and oversized files are directly rejected with a clear error before loading, preventing context window overflows. ⟦Much like an automatic document scanner tray that actively rejects unsupported transparent plastic sheets or bulky hardcover books exceeding one hundred pages at the feeder with a clear error warning, never forcing them into the rollers to prevent paper jams and internal mechanical damage.⟧

items.original: Fixed `view_file` attempting to parse non-UTF-8 binary files as text or loading files larger than 100 MB into the model context; unsupported binary formats and oversized files are now rejected with a clear error before overflowing the context window.

title.zh-TW: Gemini API 工作階段保留前輪思考區塊，並正確傳遞思考簽章
title.en: Gemini API Sessions Retain Thinking Blocks from Prior Turns and Correctly Propagate Thought Signatures

body.zh-TW: 透過金鑰與模型展開多輪深度交談，上一輪的思考脈絡現在能完好延續。⟦恰似數學競賽選手在多輪解題時保留每一步草稿演算，並在每段推導末端加蓋防偽個人戳記，交卷時所有先前的思考手稿與印鑑都能完整夾帶遞交，不會在進入下一題時把前一題的推論過程整張撕毀。⟧以前透過 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 啟動 Gemini API 工作階段時，每當使用者送出後續的新訊息，系統往往會遺失先前對話輪次中的模型思考區塊。同時，文字段落與思考段落上的思考簽章（用來驗證推論過程完整性與身分的數位記號）也無法正常傳遞。這兩項缺陷現在皆已修正，模型的思考紀錄與簽章能在多輪對話中順暢保留並正確傳播。
body.en: When engaging in multi-turn in-depth conversations with models via API keys, the thinking context from prior turns is now cleanly preserved. ⟦Just like a math competition contestant preserving draft calculations for every step across multiple problem-solving rounds and stamping an anti-counterfeit personal seal at the end of each derivation, so that all prior thought manuscripts and seals are submitted together without tearing up earlier reasoning when moving to the next question.⟧ Previously, when launching Gemini API sessions via `GEMINI_API_KEY`, sending subsequent user messages often caused the system to drop model thinking blocks from previous conversation turns. Additionally, thought signatures (digital markers used to verify the integrity and identity of reasoning processes) on text and thought parts failed to propagate properly. Both defects have now been fixed, allowing model thinking records and signatures to be smoothly retained and correctly propagated across multiple conversation turns.

items.original: Fixed Gemini API (`GEMINI_API_KEY`) sessions dropping model thinking blocks from prior turns on subsequent user messages and failing to propagate thought signatures on text and thought parts.

title.zh-TW: 產出物審查修復父路徑比對，對話分支與快照排除系統內部目錄
title.en: Artifact Review Fixes Parent Path Matching; Conversation Forks and Snapshots Exclude Internal System Directories

body.zh-TW: 審查程式產出物或建立對話分支，專案內部目錄的管理現在更加乾淨俐落。以前若在 `.gemini/` 之上的父目錄路徑中包含 `scratch` 等被忽略的路徑名稱，產出物審查（檢視程式碼生成成果的檢查面板）常會意外失效而無法觸發。此外，在執行對話分支或快照復原時，過去常會多餘複製內部專用的 `.system_generated/subagents` 與 `.system_generated/worktrees` 資料夾，且在刪除對話時也未清理子代理人的後設資料。如今這些管理問題均已修復，分支與復原不再夾帶內部目錄，刪除對話時也會同步清除子代理人紀錄。⟦如同建築事務所封存設計專案時妥善區隔公開成果與內部暫存，分流衍生新圖紙時主動排除草稿夾裡的臨時施工模型與分身圖層，專案結案銷毀時也同步清空各協力小組的派工備忘錄。⟧
body.en: When reviewing code artifacts or branching conversations, internal project directory management is now much cleaner. Previously, if a parent directory path above `.gemini/` contained skipped path names such as `scratch`, artifact review (an inspection panel for reviewing generated code outputs) often failed to trigger. In addition, when executing conversation forks or snapshot reverts, internal `.system_generated/subagents` and `.system_generated/worktrees` directories were unnecessarily copied, and deleting conversations failed to clean up subagent metadata. These management issues have now been resolved: forks and reverts no longer include internal directories, and deleting a conversation cleanly purges subagent records. ⟦Like an architecture firm archiving design projects by properly separating public deliverables from internal temp files, actively excluding temporary construction models and duplicate draft layers when branching new blueprints, and clearing assignment memos across partner teams when closing and destroying a project.⟧

items.original: Fixed artifact review failing to trigger when a directory name above `.gemini/` matched a skipped path component such as `scratch`, prevented conversation forks and snapshot reverts from copying internal `.system_generated/subagents` and `.system_generated/worktrees` directories, and cleaned up subagent metadata records when deleting a conversation.

title.zh-TW: 修復已刪除對話在背景重新連線時誤建為空白 `SQLite` 資料庫
title.en: Fixes Deleted Conversations Recreated as Empty `SQLite` Databases on Background Reconnection

body.zh-TW: 手動清空不需要的舊對話紀錄，已經被刪除的歷史檔案絕不再死灰復燃。⟦有如銀行客戶前往櫃台辦理結清銷戶後，即使後台批次排程稍後才再次連線清查餘額，系統也絕不會因為收到查詢請求，就莫名在金庫中自動重新立起一個連帳號欄位都沒有的空白保險箱。⟧以前在使用者刪除對話紀錄之後，若有背景查詢作業嘗試重新連線，往往會在底層硬生生重新建立起一筆空白且缺乏資料結構的 `SQLite` 資料庫檔案。這些幽靈檔案不僅徒增混亂，也無法正常讀取。這個幽靈重建問題現在已經徹底修復，背景查詢重新連線時不會再擅自生成空白資料庫，刪除對話確實清爽乾淨。
body.en: When manually clearing unwanted conversation histories, deleted history files will never resurface. ⟦Like a bank customer closing an account at the counter, where even if backend batch schedules reconnect later to check balances, the system never automatically erects an empty safe in the vault lacking even account fields just because an inquiry request was received.⟧ Previously, after a user deleted conversation histories, any background queries attempting to reconnect would recreate empty, schema-less `SQLite` database files underneath. These ghost files added clutter and could not be read properly. This ghost recreation bug has now been completely resolved; background queries reconnecting after deletion no longer generate empty databases, keeping conversation deletions truly clean.

items.original: Fixed deleted conversations being recreated as empty, schema-less SQLite database files when background queries reconnected after deletion.

title.zh-TW: 無工作區對話維持獨立隔離，不再意外繼承其他工作階段自訂路徑
title.en: Workspaceless Conversations Maintain Strict Isolation, No Longer Inheriting Custom Paths from Other Sessions

body.zh-TW: 不在任何專案目錄下隨手開啟終端機，獨立交談環境現在具備完善的隔離邊界。以前在未指定工作區資料夾的狀態下啟動新對話，該工作階段往往會意外繼承其他正在運行的開啟工作階段中的專案路徑與自訂設定。這種跨工作階段的設定滲漏，容易導致臨時對話誤讀了無關專案的客製化規則或檔案目錄。這個隔離缺陷現在已經修好，未指定工作區的對話會維持純粹獨立，不再擅自套用其他工作階段的環境路徑與自訂設定。⟦這好比走進共享空間租用一張臨時空桌，桌面上乾淨清空，既不會莫名翻出隔壁專案工作室遺留的門禁磁卡與私人物料，也不會意外套用其他租客專屬的自訂燈光偏好。⟧
body.en: When launching the terminal outside of any project directory, standalone conversation environments now maintain proper isolation boundaries. Previously, when starting a new conversation without a workspace folder, the session often inadvertently inherited project paths and customizations from other open sessions running concurrently. This cross-session leak caused ad-hoc conversations to mistakenly read irrelevant project rules or file directories. This isolation defect has now been fixed: conversations launched without a workspace folder remain purely standalone, no longer inheriting environment paths and custom settings from other sessions. ⟦Much like renting a temporary hot desk in a shared workspace with a clean, clear surface, where you neither uncover access keycards and personal materials left behind by adjacent project studios nor inadvertently adopt another tenant's custom lighting preferences.⟧

items.original: Fixed conversations launched without a workspace folder inheriting workspace paths and customizations from other open sessions.

entries: Added support for `excludeDefaultComponents: true` in custom agent Markdown frontmatter, allowing custom agents to opt out of default prompt sections and built-in tools while preserving post-invocation hooks.

Improved model API error resilience and diagnostics: transient `genai.APIError` failures (`502`, `503`, `504`, per-minute `429` rate limits, and mid-stream interruptions) automatically retry in-process with exponential backoff while preserving completed tool call outputs, and unrecovered `503` and `429` responses surface clear user-facing error messages.

Improved MCP and provider tool schema validation to preserve open object schemas (such as `{"type": "object"}` or explicit `additionalProperties: true`) instead of rejecting undeclared arguments on schemas that allow them.
Improved per-turn responsiveness and reduced memory usage when opening large conversations.

Fixed `--continue` starting a brand-new conversation when launched from a subdirectory, after a crash, or while another session is open in the same workspace; it now falls back to the most recent non-empty conversation in the current workspace or its parent/child directories.
Fixed full-screen blank flashes in inline mode when content first pushes to scrollback, at the end of a turn, or when clearing the screen with `Ctrl+L`.
Fixed remote companion UIs connected to an interactive CLI session via Remote Control displaying an unauthenticated sign-in screen instead of the active session's signed-in state.
Fixed the status line reporting the terminal sandbox as disabled when the session was launched with the `--sandbox` command-line flag.
Fixed image zoom keys (`Ctrl+=` and `Ctrl+-`) and the footer zoom hint appearing in the artifact viewer when a Mermaid diagram is rendered in ASCII mode instead of as a Kitty image.

title.zh-TW: 自訂代理人支援精簡配置，排除預設提示詞與工具並保留掛鉤
title.en: Custom agents support lean configuration, excluding default prompts and tools while preserving hooks

body.zh-TW:
設計專精特定任務的自訂代理人時，你現在能擁有一張完全乾淨的畫布。在代理人 Markdown 檔案頂端的前言設定（在文件開頭以橫線包夾的設定區塊）加入 `excludeDefaultComponents: true`，便能選擇不載入系統預設的提示詞區段與內建工具，只留下你親自指定的行為邏輯。這項設定能避免通用指令干擾專業發揮。而任務結束後的掛鉤（在特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）依舊完整保留，讓自訂自動化流程順暢運作。⟦宛如訂製專業賽車時選擇拆空內裝的輕量化車體，移除了預設的後座與原廠音響，只留下純粹操控配備，但底盤的安全感應線路依然維持連動。⟧

```yaml
---
name: my-specialist
excludeDefaultComponents: true
---
```
body.en:
When designing custom agents tailored for specialized tasks, you now have a completely blank canvas. Adding `excludeDefaultComponents: true` to the frontmatter of an agent's Markdown file allows you to opt out of loading system default prompt sections and built-in tools, keeping only your explicitly specified behavior logic. This setting prevents general-purpose instructions from interfering with specialized capabilities. Meanwhile, post-task hooks remain fully preserved, keeping custom automated workflows running smoothly. ⟦Just like ordering a purpose-built race car with a stripped lightweight chassis, where default rear seats and factory stereo are removed to keep only pure driving controls, while the safety sensor wiring in the chassis remains connected.⟧

```yaml
---
name: my-specialist
excludeDefaultComponents: true
---
```

items.original: Added support for `excludeDefaultComponents: true` in custom agent Markdown frontmatter, allowing custom agents to opt out of default prompt sections and built-in tools while preserving post-invocation hooks.

title.zh-TW: 模型 API 強化錯誤重試機制，保留工具產出並提供清楚診斷
title.en: Model API strengthens error retry mechanism, preserving tool outputs and providing clear diagnostics

body.zh-TW: 面對遠端模型伺服器偶發的網路壅塞或限流，工具現在具備更沉著的容錯韌性。⟦宛如在自動販賣機投幣購買熱飲遇到出杯口短暫卡頓，機台會主動間隔等待並重新嘗試，妥善保留已落下的紙杯，若最終仍無法出料也會在螢幕亮起明確的缺料警示。⟧以前連線時若撞上暫時性的 `genai.APIError` 錯誤，執行流程往往直接中斷。現在無論是 `502`、`503`、`504` 伺服器異常、每分鐘觸發的 `429` 速率限制，或是傳輸串流中途中斷，程式都會在內部以指數退避（重試等待時間隨次數倍增的做法）自動重試。重試期間已完成的工具呼叫產出會完整保留，不再白白作廢。若重試後仍未能成功復原，系統會針對 `503` 與 `429` 狀況顯示清楚易懂的錯誤提示，不再丟出晦澀難懂的內部代碼。
body.en: When facing occasional network congestion or rate limits from remote model servers, the tool now exhibits calmer fault resilience. ⟦Like buying a hot drink from a vending machine and encountering a brief jam at the dispenser chute: the machine automatically waits at intervals and retries, properly preserving the dropped cup, and illuminates a clear out-of-stock warning on the screen if it ultimately cannot dispense.⟧ Previously, encountering transient `genai.APIError` failures during a connection would often abort execution immediately. Now, whether dealing with `502`, `503`, or `504` server errors, per-minute `429` rate limits, or mid-stream transmission interruptions, the program automatically retries in-process using exponential backoff. Completed tool call outputs during retries are fully preserved rather than wasted. If recovery still fails after retrying, the system displays clear and understandable error messages for `503` and `429` situations instead of throwing obscure internal error codes.

items.original: Improved model API error resilience and diagnostics: transient `genai.APIError` failures (`502`, `503`, `504`, per-minute `429` rate limits, and mid-stream interruptions) automatically retry in-process with exponential backoff while preserving completed tool call outputs, and unrecovered `503` and `429` responses surface clear user-facing error messages.

title.zh-TW: MCP 與工具結構驗證放寬，保留開放物件與自訂參數
title.en: MCP and tool schema validation relaxed, preserving open objects and custom arguments

body.zh-TW: 串接各類外部擴充工具時，規格檢驗不再把合法的彈性輸入擋在門外。使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）或各家模型提供者的擴充工具時，舊版結構驗證機制過於嚴格。即使工具規格本身允許開放物件結構描述（schema，規範資料格式與欄位型別的結構定義），例如宣告為 `{"type": "object"}` 或明確寫出 `additionalProperties: true`，系統過去仍會拒絕傳入任何未預先宣告的引數。現在檢驗邏輯全面改善，能妥善保留這些開放物件結構，讓合規允許額外參數的工具順利接收資料。⟦好比前往公證處填寫資產申報單，欄位末端若明確勾選了「其他動產」或備註允許自由補充，審查櫃台便會如實受理附帶清單，不再挑剔額外寫入的項目未列在制式表格上。⟧
body.en: When integrating external extension tools, specification checks no longer lock out valid, flexible inputs. When using MCP or provider extension tools, the previous schema validation mechanism was overly strict. Even if a tool specification itself allowed open object schemas (such as declaring `{"type": "object"}` or explicitly setting `additionalProperties: true`), the system previously rejected any undeclared arguments. The validation logic is now improved to properly preserve these open object schemas, allowing tools that permit extra parameters to receive data smoothly. ⟦Just like filling out an asset declaration form at a notary office: if the end of a field explicitly checks "other movable property" or notes allow free additions, the review counter accepts the attached list as-is, no longer rejecting extra written items simply because they were not listed on the standard form.⟧

items.original: Improved MCP and provider tool schema validation to preserve open object schemas (such as `{"type": "object"}` or explicit `additionalProperties: true`) instead of rejecting undeclared arguments on schemas that allow them.

title.zh-TW: 開啟大型對話降低記憶體佔用，每輪互動回應更敏捷
title.en: Opening large conversations reduces memory usage, making per-turn responses more agile

body.zh-TW: 重新載入累積大量歷史紀錄的長篇對話時，終端機的操作手感現在依然輕快。⟦這好比翻開一整箱厚重的工程施工藍圖，經過重新折疊與編目整理，攤在桌上不再佔滿整張辦公桌，每次翻到特定樓層做標記也隨翻隨寫、毫無延宕。⟧以前開啟對話紀錄特別長的工作階段（session，從啟動到結束的一整段對話歷程）時，龐大的歷史內容往往會迅速堆高記憶體用量。隨著對話越來越長，每輪互動的送出與回應也常因此變得遲緩。現在開啟大型對話時的每輪回應速度顯著改善，同時有效降低了記憶體消耗。即使面對篇幅極長的工作階段，每次對話往返都能維持順暢反應。
body.en: When reloading lengthy conversations with accumulated history, terminal operations remain snappy. ⟦Like opening a heavy box of engineering construction blueprints that have been refolded and cataloged: spreading them out no longer occupies the entire desk, and flipping to a specific floor to make notes is immediate without any delay.⟧ Previously, opening sessions with extensive conversation histories would rapidly inflate memory usage. As conversations grew longer, sending and receiving responses per turn frequently became sluggish. Now, per-turn responsiveness when opening large conversations is significantly improved while effectively reducing memory consumption. Even in exceptionally long sessions, each conversational turn maintains smooth responsiveness.

items.original: Improved per-turn responsiveness and reduced memory usage when opening large conversations.

title.zh-TW: --continue 支援階層備援搜尋，子目錄與當機後不開新對話
title.en: --continue supports hierarchical fallback search, avoiding new conversations in subdirectories or after crashes

body.zh-TW:
想要迅速接續上一回的中斷進度，恢復對話的指令現在更值得信賴。以前執行 `--continue` 旗標時，只要終端機位於專案的子目錄、先前發生過異常當機，或者同一工作區內恰好有另一個工作階段（session，從啟動到關閉的完整使用過程）正在運行，系統往往會誤判並強制開出一筆全新空白對話。這讓使用者找不到原本的上下文紀錄。現在這項缺陷已經修好，指令會啟動智慧備援（fallback，在主路徑失效時自動切換至替代方案的容錯設計）機制，自動搜尋當前工作區及其父目錄、子目錄，精準找回最近一次非空的歷史對話。⟦恰似工匠走進分流的加工側間準備繼續施工，即使方才經歷了意外跳電、或隔壁主工位正有人借用工具，他依然能在工具架的主層或鄰近抽屜裡，精準摸出最後那份尚未結案的工件繼續雕琢。⟧

```
# 接續當前工作區最近一次非空對話
agy --continue
```
body.en:
When resuming interrupted progress from a previous session, the continuation command is now much more dependable. Previously, running the `--continue` flag would often mistakenly force a brand-new blank conversation if the terminal was located in a project subdirectory, after an abnormal crash, or while another session was running in the same workspace. This left users unable to find their original context history. This flaw has now been fixed; the command initiates a fallback mechanism that automatically searches the current workspace along with its parent and child directories to accurately retrieve the most recent non-empty conversation. ⟦Much like a craftsman stepping into a branch workshop to resume work: even after a sudden power outage or while someone borrows tools at the main workstation next door, he can still reach into the tool rack's main shelf or adjacent drawers to accurately retrieve the last unfinished piece and continue carving.⟧

```
# Resume the most recent non-empty conversation in the current workspace
agy --continue
```

items.original: Fixed `--continue` starting a brand-new conversation when launched from a subdirectory, after a crash, or while another session is open in the same workspace; it now falls back to the most recent non-empty conversation in the current workspace or its parent/child directories.

title.zh-TW: 行內模式修復全螢幕空白閃爍，捲動與清畫面視覺更平順
title.en: Inline mode fixes full-screen blank flashes, smoothing scrolling and screen clearing

body.zh-TW: 長時間在終端機中緊盯對話輸出，刺眼的畫面閃爍不再打擾你的專注。在行內模式（inline mode，直接在終端機當前游標處嵌入文字的顯示方式）下，使用者過去常常會撞見令人不適的全螢幕空白閃爍。這種刺眼的閃動特別容易發生在文字輸出首次被推入回捲緩衝區（scrollback，終端機用來保留上方歷史畫面的暫存區）的那一刻、每一輪對話即將結束的收尾瞬間，或是按下 `Ctrl+L` 快捷鍵嘗試清空螢幕之時。這個畫面閃爍問題現在已經徹底修復，各種切換情境下都能維持穩定的視覺感受。⟦彷彿在老舊放映廳看電影遇到換膠捲捲軸，以前每逢段落切換或清潔布幕時總會突然白光一閃刺傷眼睛，如今更換了數位連續放映機，轉場時畫面銜接安靜平穩。⟧
body.en: When focusing on conversational output in the terminal for long periods, glaring screen flashes no longer disrupt your concentration. In inline mode, users previously often encountered jarring full-screen blank flashes. This glaring flash occurred especially when text output was first pushed into the scrollback buffer, at the closing moment of each conversation turn, or when pressing `Ctrl+L` to clear the screen. This screen flashing issue is now completely fixed, maintaining a stable visual experience across all transition scenarios. ⟦Like watching a movie in an old cinema during a film reel change: paragraph transitions or screen cleanings previously triggered a sudden flash of white light that stung the eyes, but with a new digital continuous projector, transitions now connect quietly and smoothly.⟧

items.original: Fixed full-screen blank flashes in inline mode when content first pushes to scrollback, at the end of a turn, or when clearing the screen with `Ctrl+L`.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 隨附介面狀態修復，即時反映已登入工作階段
title.en: Remote Control companion UI state fixed, instantly reflecting signed-in sessions

body.zh-TW: 使用遠端裝置協同操作終端機時，隨附介面現在能準確同步你已登入的身分。⟦好似持智慧手環與跑步機連線同步運動數據，手環螢幕接通瞬間便會直接顯示當前登入的會員姓名，不再跳回初始歡迎頁逼你重新掃描卡片。⟧以前透過 `Remote Control` 將遠端隨附介面連線至互動式命令列工作階段（session，從啟動到結束的一整段操作歷程）時，介面端常出現異常狀況。它不會顯示當前活動工作階段的有效登入狀態，反而會錯誤彈出未通過驗證的登入畫面，阻礙使用者操作。這個狀態顯示問題現在已經修好，遠端介面連線後能直接反映正常的登入狀態。
body.en: When using remote devices to collaboratively operate the terminal, the companion UI now accurately synchronizes your signed-in identity. ⟦Just like pairing a fitness tracker with a treadmill to sync workout data: the moment the tracker screen connects, it immediately displays the currently logged-in member's name instead of jumping back to the initial welcome page and forcing you to rescan your card.⟧ Previously, connecting a remote companion UI to an interactive CLI session via `Remote Control` often caused an abnormal state on the UI side. Instead of displaying the active session's authenticated sign-in state, it erroneously showed an unauthenticated sign-in screen, hindering operations. This status display issue is now fixed, allowing remote interfaces to directly reflect the normal signed-in state upon connection.

items.original: Fixed remote companion UIs connected to an interactive CLI session via Remote Control displaying an unauthenticated sign-in screen instead of the active session's signed-in state.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列如實反映終端機沙盒狀態，解除旗標設定下的顯示誤判
title.en: Status line accurately reflects terminal sandbox state, resolving false display under flag setting

body.zh-TW:
開啟隔離防護執行不可信指令時，底部狀態提示不再引起虛驚。當你在啟動命令列時加入了 `--sandbox` 命令列旗標，程式明明已經替該工作階段（session，從啟動到關閉的完整執行過程）啟用了終端機沙盒防護。然而畫面底部的狀態列（顯示目前模式與環境資訊的即時通知列）過去卻會錯誤回報沙盒為停用狀態，容易讓人誤以為隔離環境未生效。這個顯示問題現在已經修正，只要使用該旗標啟動，狀態列便會如實反映沙盒的啟用狀態。⟦這如同實驗室操作員戴上護目鏡並扳下通風櫥排氣閥，排風扇明明已正常抽風運轉，警示面板上的指示燈卻誤亮著「排氣已關閉」，校正接線後指示燈終於真實反映抽風狀態。⟧

```
# 以終端機沙盒防護模式啟動工作階段
agy --sandbox
```
body.en:
When enabling isolated protection to execute untrusted commands, bottom status hints no longer cause false alarms. When launching the command line with the `--sandbox` flag, the program properly enables terminal sandbox protection for that session. However, the status line at the bottom of the screen previously erroneously reported the sandbox as disabled, easily leading users to believe the isolated environment was not active. This display issue is now fixed; launching with this flag ensures the status line accurately reflects the sandbox's enabled state. ⟦Much like a lab operator putting on safety goggles and pulling the fume hood exhaust valve: while the exhaust fan is running normally, the indicator light on the warning panel mistakenly shows "Exhaust Off"; after correcting the wiring, the light finally accurately reflects the ventilation status.⟧

```
# Launch session with terminal sandbox protection mode
agy --sandbox
```

items.original: Fixed the status line reporting the terminal sandbox as disabled when the session was launched with the `--sandbox` command-line flag.

title.zh-TW: Mermaid 純文字圖表移除縮放提示，檢視器介面回歸清爽
title.en: Mermaid plain-text diagrams remove zoom hints, restoring clean viewer interface

body.zh-TW: 在終端機檢視流程圖或架構圖時，畫面控制項不再出現用不上的快捷鍵提示。當你在產出物檢視器（artifact viewer，查看程式碼或圖表等生成成果的專用檢視面板）中瀏覽 Mermaid 圖表時，若圖表是以 ASCII 純文字模式而非 Kitty 圖片模式進行算繪，終端機過去依然會顯示圖片專用的縮放按鍵提示。這導致底部的頁尾提示欄列出無效的 `Ctrl+=` 與 `Ctrl+-` 縮放快捷鍵，按下去也沒有實際縮放效果。這個介面提示問題現在已經修正，純文字圖表不再顯示多餘的圖片縮放提示。⟦宛如閱讀以純文字打字機排印的黑白公文，閱讀器底端卻跳出僅適用於高解析度相片的多點觸控手勢指引，移走無效提示後版面回歸乾淨俐落。⟧
body.en: When viewing flowcharts or architecture diagrams in the terminal, UI controls no longer display unusable shortcut hints. When browsing Mermaid diagrams in the artifact viewer, if a diagram was rendered in ASCII plain-text mode rather than Kitty image mode, the terminal previously still showed image zoom key hints. This caused the bottom footer hint bar to list ineffective `Ctrl+=` and `Ctrl+-` zoom shortcuts that had no actual zooming effect when pressed. This UI hint issue is now fixed, so plain-text diagrams no longer display redundant image zoom hints. ⟦Like reading a black-and-white official document printed on a plain typewriter, only for the bottom of the reader to pop up multi-touch gesture guides meant exclusively for high-resolution photos; removing the invalid hints restores a clean, uncluttered layout.⟧

items.original: Fixed image zoom keys (`Ctrl+=` and `Ctrl+-`) and the footer zoom hint appearing in the artifact viewer when a Mermaid diagram is rendered in ASCII mode instead of as a Kitty image.

entries: Added the `remote-control start`, `remote-control status`, and `remote-control stop` subcommands to run the CLI as a background service registered with your operating system's service manager so your machine stays reachable across logouts and reboots; `remote-control start --name <label>` sets a custom machine label in the Remote Control instance list, and `--session` scopes the service to your active login session.

Improved half-page scrolling across all scrollable views — including altscreen mode, the diff viewer, and read-only detail panels where `ctrl+d` no longer triggers the exit prompt — and set `shift+up` and `shift+down` as customizable default keybindings for half-page navigation (`navigation.half_page_up` and `navigation.half_page_down`).

Fixed prompts or model responses blocked by content safety filters failing with a spurious "no candidate found" error, ending silently with an empty turn, or repeatedly retrying the rejected input; the CLI now surfaces a clear content-filter stop reason.
Fixed temporary working files written to the agent `scratch/` directory triggering recursive filesystem watchers and appearing as noisy entries in the artifact review panel and checkpoints.
Fixed MCP servers bundled inside globally installed plugins failing to initialize at CLI startup or failing to update their running status when plugins are enabled or disabled.
Fixed third-party MCP server tools failing schema validation when their input schemas omit `additionalProperties`.
Fixed unnecessary filesystem customization discovery walks running on every user message even when no slash command is invoked, reducing latency before the agent begins responding.
Fixed every log line in `cli.log` and background daemon subcommand output being prefixed with a spurious `ERROR: logging before google.Init` message.

Fixed the macOS `remote-control` background service terminating shortly after startup when launched by the system service manager, `remote-control start` and `remote-control stop` leaving legacy installer-script background services running, and the Remote Control setting being unavailable when your access comes from a paid Google Cloud project.
Fixed older conversations failing to load with an `unknown step type` error when resumed.

title.zh-TW: `remote-control` 支援註冊為系統背景服務，離線重開機皆能保持連線
title.en: `remote-control` can now be registered as an OS background service, keeping connections alive across logouts and reboots

body.zh-TW:
出門在外想從遠端連回工作主機，最怕主機登出或重開機後連線中斷。⟦好比在通訊鐵塔安裝不斷電中繼發射器，就算人員離場或總電源重啟，設備依然持續發送信號，名冊上能自訂代號且不中斷連線。⟧工具新增了 `remote-control start`、`remote-control status` 與 `remote-control stop` 子指令，可將命令列工具註冊為作業系統背景服務（常駐在系統底層運行的程序）。即使登出帳號或重新開機，主機依然保持可連線狀態。執行 `remote-control start --name <label>` 能在實體清單自訂辨識標籤，加入 `--session` 旗標則能將服務限制在當前登入的工作階段。

```
# 註冊為作業系統常駐服務，重開機或登出皆保持連線
agy remote-control start --name "office-mac"

# 僅限定在目前登入的工作階段
agy remote-control start --session

# 查詢服務狀態與停止服務
agy remote-control status
agy remote-control stop
```
body.en:
When connecting back to your workstation remotely while away, the biggest headache is losing the connection after logging out or rebooting. ⟦It is like installing an uninterruptible relay transmitter on a communications tower: even if staff leave or the main power is cycled, the equipment keeps broadcasting signals with a customizable roster label without dropping the connection.⟧ The tool has added the `remote-control start`, `remote-control status`, and `remote-control stop` subcommands, allowing you to register the CLI as an operating system background service. Even if you log out of your account or restart the machine, the host remains reachable. Running `remote-control start --name <label>` lets you set a custom identification label in the instance list, while adding the `--session` flag restricts the service to your current login session.

```
# Register as an OS background service to stay reachable across reboots and logouts
agy remote-control start --name "office-mac"

# Scope strictly to the current login session
agy remote-control start --session

# Check service status and stop the service
agy remote-control status
agy remote-control stop
```

items.original: Added the `remote-control start`, `remote-control status`, and `remote-control stop` subcommands to run the CLI as a background service registered with your operating system's service manager so your machine stays reachable across logouts and reboots; `remote-control start --name <label>` sets a custom machine label in the Remote Control instance list, and `--session` scopes the service to your active login session.

title.zh-TW: 半頁捲動支援更多畫面與預設快捷鍵，唯讀面板不再誤退
title.en: Half-page scrolling expands to more views with default keybindings, preventing accidental exits in read-only panels

items.original: Improved half-page scrolling across all scrollable views — including altscreen mode, the diff viewer, and read-only detail panels where `ctrl+d` no longer triggers the exit prompt — and set `shift+up` and `shift+down` as customizable default keybindings for half-page navigation (`navigation.half_page_up` and `navigation.half_page_down`).

title.zh-TW: 內容安全過濾器提供明確中斷原因，告別空回覆與無效重試
title.en: Content safety filters now provide clear stop reasons, eliminating empty responses and pointless retries

body.zh-TW: 當你輸入的提示詞或模型產生的回覆觸動內容安全防線時，終端機不再用含糊的錯誤訊息讓人摸不著頭緒。⟦這宛如海關安檢人員攔下違禁包裹，過去若不發一語直接沒收、或者反覆將包裹推回輸送帶重新掃描，都會讓寄件人困惑，現在安檢處會明確開立註記違規類別的查驗單。⟧以前只要提示或生成內容被內容安全過濾器（防止有害或違規內容的審查機制）阻擋，系統常會跳出無關的 `no candidate found` 假錯誤、整輪對話靜默結束不留文字，甚至反覆重試被拒絕的輸入。現在命令列工具會直接顯示明確的 `content-filter` 停止原因，讓使用者一眼看清是哪裡觸發了安全審查。
body.en: When an input prompt or model-generated response triggers safety guardrails, the terminal no longer leaves you baffled with vague errors. ⟦It is like customs security intercepting a restricted package: rather than silently confiscating it or repeatedly returning it to the conveyor belt to rescan, the inspection desk now issues an inspection slip clearly noting the violation category.⟧ Previously, when prompts or generated content were blocked by content safety filters, the system often threw spurious `no candidate found` errors, ended the entire turn silently with an empty response, or repeatedly retried rejected input. The CLI now surfaces an explicit `content-filter` stop reason, letting you clearly see what triggered the safety review.

items.original: Fixed prompts or model responses blocked by content safety filters failing with a spurious "no candidate found" error, ending silently with an empty turn, or repeatedly retrying the rejected input; the CLI now surfaces a clear content-filter stop reason.

title.zh-TW: `scratch/` 草稿檔排除於監聽範圍外，成品面板與檢查點回歸乾淨
title.en: `scratch/` drafts are now excluded from watchers, keeping artifact panels and checkpoints clean

body.zh-TW: 讓代理人寫臨時程式碼或運算草稿時，你的工作面板與版本紀錄不再被暫存檔案洗版。當 AI 代理人在名為 `scratch/` 的草稿暫存資料夾中建立臨時工作檔案時，過去會意外觸發檔案系統的遞迴監聽機制（持續追蹤目錄內所有子檔案變動的背景監控）。這導致許多僅用於中途運算的臨時檔案，全被當成正式成果塞進成品審查面板（審視程式碼產出物的檢視介面）。存檔檢查點更因此留下一堆無關的雜訊紀錄。這個問題已經修好，草稿檔不再灌進成品面板與檢查點。⟦這好似木匠在工作檯旁設置刨花收集桶，刨削過程產生的碎木屑會直接落入桶中，不會被當成精緻成品擺進展示櫃，更不會寫入最終交件清單。⟧
body.en: When an agent drafts scratchpad code or intermediate computations, your workspace panels and version history will no longer be cluttered with temporary files. Previously, when an AI agent wrote temporary working files to the `scratch/` directory, it accidentally triggered recursive filesystem watchers. As a result, intermediate computational files were treated as finished deliverables and flooded into the artifact review panel. Checkpoints were also polluted with noisy, irrelevant entries. This is now fixed, and scratch files no longer show up in the artifact panel or checkpoints. ⟦It is like a carpenter placing a wood shaving collector beside the workbench: discarded wood shavings fall directly into the bin instead of being displayed in the showroom as finished crafts or recorded on the final delivery manifest.⟧

items.original: Fixed temporary working files written to the agent `scratch/` directory triggering recursive filesystem watchers and appearing as noisy entries in the artifact review panel and checkpoints.

title.zh-TW: 全域外掛 MCP 伺服器啟動初始化修復，工具架構放寬相容
title.en: Global plugin MCP servers fix startup initialization, relaxing tool schema validation compatibility

body.zh-TW: 擴充外部工具時，伺服器的啟動連線與工具檢驗現在更加可靠。使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充功能時，過去安裝在全域外掛中的隨附伺服器常在命令列工具啟動時初始化失敗，在外掛啟用或停用時也無法即時同步更新運行狀態。此外，部分第三方工具的輸入規格若未明確寫出 `additionalProperties` 設定，在舊版架構驗證時會被判定不合規而無法呼叫。如今這兩項瑕疵皆已修正，全域外掛隨附的伺服器能如期啟動並隨開關切換狀態，省略該欄位的第三方工具也能正常通過檢驗。⟦有如在攝影棚組裝各廠牌的外接閃光燈，機頂熱靴通電時所有外接燈具會同步就緒且開關即時連動，就算某些副廠配件的說明書少印了一行補充宣告，接上時也能順利通過器材相容測試。⟧
body.en: Expanding external tools is now much more reliable for both server startup and tool schema validation. When using MCP extensions, bundled servers inside globally installed plugins previously failed to initialize at CLI startup and failed to update their running status when plugins were enabled or disabled. Additionally, when third-party tool input schemas omitted the `additionalProperties` setting, legacy schema validation rejected them as non-compliant and blocked tool invocation. Both issues have now been resolved: bundled servers in global plugins initialize as expected while syncing state changes, and third-party tools omitting that field pass validation normally. ⟦It is like setting up multi-brand external flashes in a photography studio: when the camera hot shoe powers on, all external strobes ready up simultaneously with synced switches, and even if a third-party accessory manual misses a supplementary declaration line, it still passes equipment compatibility checks smoothly.⟧

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers bundled inside globally installed plugins failing to initialize at CLI startup or failing to update their running status when plugins are enabled or disabled.
Fixed third-party MCP server tools failing schema validation when their input schemas omit `additionalProperties`.

title.zh-TW: 略過非指令訊息的磁碟設定搜尋，加快代理人作答起步
title.en: Bypassing disk customization discovery for non-command messages speeds up initial agent responses

body.zh-TW: 平常在對話框裡敲入日常問題，你現在能更快看見 AI 開始作答。⟦好比顧客向超商櫃台詢問簡單路況，店員能當場開口回答，不必每次都特地跑回後方庫房翻查厚重的員工交接手冊與促銷規章。⟧過去只要使用者送出一則訊息，即使完全沒有輸入 `/` 斜線開頭的特殊指令，系統依然會在磁碟中進行客製化探索遍歷（在檔案系統逐層搜尋技能與規則設定檔的掃描程序）。這項多餘的搜尋每次都平白耗費時間，拖慢了代理人動手回應的速度。現在系統只在真正呼叫指令時才進行搜尋，有效降低了代理人開始作答前的等待延遲。
body.en: When typing ordinary questions into the chat box, you will now see the AI begin responding much faster. ⟦It is like a customer asking a convenience store clerk for simple directions: the clerk answers immediately without having to run to the backroom storage to dig through thick employee handover handbooks and promotional manuals every single time.⟧ Previously, whenever a user sent a message—even one without any `/` slash command—the system still performed filesystem customization discovery walks. This redundant search wasted time on every turn, adding noticeable delay before the agent began answering. The system now performs disk searches only when a command is actually invoked, effectively reducing response startup latency.

items.original: Fixed unnecessary filesystem customization discovery walks running on every user message even when no slash command is invoked, reducing latency before the agent begins responding.

title.zh-TW: `cli.log` 移除虛假錯誤前綴，背景守護行程日誌不再洗版
title.en: `cli.log` removes spurious error prefixes, clearing log clutter from background daemon output

body.zh-TW: 查看記錄檔或排查系統狀態時，滿螢幕的假警報不再干擾你的判斷。檢視 `cli.log` 記錄檔或執行背景守護程序（daemon，在系統背景運作的常駐服務）的子指令輸出時，終端機與記錄檔現在恢復了乾淨面貌。過去底層程式庫在完成初始化之前，每一行輸出的日誌文字開頭都會被強制加上 `ERROR: logging before google.Init` 這行虛假錯誤字串。這把正常的運作紀錄全染成刺眼的錯誤訊息，嚴重誤導除錯方向。現在這行假錯誤已經不再出現。⟦彷彿出廠檢驗員的手握號碼機卡住，在整批合格產品的外箱上都自動加蓋了「嚴重瑕疵」的紅印，如今校正了印章連動機構，唯有真正故障時才會留下警示。⟧
body.en: When inspecting log files or troubleshooting system status, screens full of false alarms will no longer mislead your investigations. Viewing `cli.log` or running background daemon subcommands now presents clean output in both logs and the terminal. Previously, before the underlying library completed initialization, every logged line was forcefully prefixed with a spurious `ERROR: logging before google.Init` string. This painted normal runtime output as alarming error messages and severely derailed debugging efforts. That spurious prefix is now gone. ⟦It is like a factory inspector's hand-held stamper getting stuck and stamping a red "critical defect" mark on every box of passing products: now that the stamping linkage is recalibrated, warning marks appear only when an actual fault occurs.⟧

items.original: Fixed every log line in `cli.log` and background daemon subcommand output being prefixed with a spurious `ERROR: logging before google.Init` message.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 修復 macOS 啟動終止與舊腳本殘留，支援付費雲端專案
title.en: Remote Control fixes macOS startup termination and legacy script leftovers, adding paid cloud project support

body.zh-TW: 在不同平台與帳號環境使用 Remote Control 背景服務時，各項運作細節現在更加穩健。⟦這宛如整修廣播電台的自動發射機房，修復了開機即跳電的故障，清空了早期舊控制器殘留的背景連線，付費會員頻道也能正常開啟轉播。⟧在 `macOS` 上由系統服務管理員啟動 `remote-control` 背景服務時，過去常在啟動後不久便異常終止，現在能穩定常駐運行。同時修正了執行 `remote-control start` 與 `remote-control stop` 時，仍會殘留舊版安裝腳本所啟動的背景服務之問題，確保背景服務乾淨交接。此外，若使用者是透過付費 `Google Cloud` 專案取得權限，先前無法開啟 `Remote Control` 設定的問題也已解決，現在能順暢啟用功能。
body.en: Operating the Remote Control background service across different platforms and account environments is now much better behaved. ⟦It is like overhauling an automated broadcast transmitter room: fixing the power trip on startup, purging lingering background connections from early legacy controllers, and enabling smooth broadcasts for paid member channels.⟧ When launched by the system service manager on `macOS`, the `remote-control` background service previously terminated shortly after startup; it now runs stably in the background. Running `remote-control start` and `remote-control stop` no longer leaves background services running from legacy installer scripts, ensuring clean service handoffs. Additionally, for users whose access comes from a paid `Google Cloud` project, the previously unavailable `Remote Control` setting has been fixed, allowing straightforward feature activation.

items.original: Fixed the macOS `remote-control` background service terminating shortly after startup when launched by the system service manager, `remote-control start` and `remote-control stop` leaving legacy installer-script background services running, and the Remote Control setting being unavailable when your access comes from a paid Google Cloud project.

title.zh-TW: 舊版對話支援相容載入，恢復歷史紀錄不再因未知步驟中斷
title.en: Legacy conversations gain backward-compatible loading, preventing resume failures on unknown steps

body.zh-TW: 想接續幾天前或更新前留下的對話記錄時，對話歷程不再因為格式不認得而拒絕載入。以前使用恢復對話功能時，若該筆歷史紀錄是在較早版本中建立，系統常因無法辨識記錄檔裡的舊版步驟格式，而跳出 `unknown step type` 錯誤中斷載入，導致整段對話完全無法開啟。現在載入解析器強化了對舊格式的向下相容能力，即使對話中包含過去定義的步驟型別，也能順利讀取並完整還原對話現場。⟦好似翻開圖書館館藏的早期手稿，即便內頁蓋著前幾代管理員留下的舊版分類戳章，新版讀取機也能順暢辨識，不再因為印章代碼停產就拒絕翻頁。⟧
body.en: When picking up past conversations from days ago or before an update, your chat history will no longer fail to load due to unrecognized formats. Previously, when resuming a conversation created in an older version, the system often failed with an `unknown step type` error because it could not recognize legacy step formats in the log, making the entire conversation unopenable. The loader parser now features improved backward compatibility for older formats, smoothly parsing legacy step types and fully restoring the conversation session. ⟦It is like opening an early archival manuscript in a library: even if internal pages bear obsolete classification stamps from earlier generations of curators, the new scanner recognizes them smoothly instead of refusing to turn the page over discontinued stamp codes.⟧

items.original: Fixed older conversations failing to load with an `unknown step type` error when resumed.

entries: Improved resilience to transient model API errors: the agent now retries errors such as `503 Unavailable` for much longer with exponential backoff, so a brief service hiccup no longer aborts your session.

Improved sign-in and startup speed by reading your signed-in identity from the stored credential instead of making a network request on every launch and after browser consent; a failed identity lookup no longer prevents sign-in from completing, and the displayed plan tier no longer briefly disappears during startup.

Improved headless (`-p`) runs to exit promptly once the final answer is delivered: the CLI waits for running background tasks and scheduled timers to finish, bound by `--print-timeout`, and leaves daemon background tasks such as dev servers running instead of terminating them.

Improved failure reporting in headless (`-p`) runs: fatal errors now appear on stderr with a stable `error:` marker, a note is printed when the response may be truncated, and runs that previously ended silently with no output now explain why.
Improved headless (`-p`) turnaround by cutting up to 200 ms of idle latency per turn and skipping the model call that generated a conversation title no one would see.

Improved tool approval prompts to say exactly what you are approving — for example `Run this command?`, `Allow access to this URL?`, or `Allow calling this tool?` — with the command-editing shortcut offered only when a command is being approved, and a `Reason:` line explaining why approval is being requested when it is not obvious, such as a hook flagging the action or a file belonging to a different project.

Improved model selection auditability: the CLI log now records whenever a model name you specify resolves to a different model, such as alias resolution, `--effort` variant selection, or replacement of a deprecated saved model.

Changed what happens when `--print-timeout` expires mid-turn: the CLI now returns the partial output it has and exits successfully with a warning on stderr, instead of failing with a timeout error; interrupts such as Ctrl+C still exit non-zero.
Changed the default permission for fetching URLs from always allowed to asking first, so the agent now requests approval before reading a URL unless you have granted access.

Fixed plugin reinstalls keeping files that had been deleted from the source: installing a plugin now replaces its managed directory exactly, installing a plugin from its own installed directory is refused instead of corrupting it, and uninstalling a plugin no longer leaves its enabled/disabled entry behind in `config.json`.

Fixed MCP servers defined by plugins resolving relative or unset working directories against the wrong location; they now resolve against the plugin's own directory so plugin-bundled scripts run correctly.
Fixed a startup race where subagents could fail to find tools from MCP servers that were still initializing.
Fixed subagents sometimes appearing stuck in a running state after they had finished — especially in very large conversations — which also left queued when-idle messages undelivered until restart.
Fixed a memory leak where every finished terminal command kept internal state alive for the rest of the session; long sessions that run many commands now use significantly less memory.
Fixed headless (`-p`) runs stalling forever on implementation-plan approval that no one could give; non-interactive runs now proceed through plan review automatically.

Fixed sign-in failing with a project access error after switching from a business account with a selected project to a personal account; stale business project and license details are now fully cleared on personal sign-in.

title.zh-TW: 遇到 503 暫時錯誤自動長重試，工作階段不中斷
title.en: Automatic extended retries on temporary 503 errors keep sessions uninterrupted

body.zh-TW: 你正請 AI 執行冗長的多步驟任務，最怕遇到遠端模型伺服器短暫壅塞。⟦好似在熱門麵包店結帳時遇到刷卡機短暫斷線，店員不會立刻退回商品並將你請出店門，而是請你稍待片刻後再次感應，直到連線恢復。⟧ 以前只要碰上 `503 Unavailable` 這類短暫的模型介面錯誤，整個正在進行的工作階段（session，從啟動到結束的一整段對話歷程）就會被迫終止。現在代理人遇到這類暫時狀況，會透過指數退避（重試等待時間隨失敗次數拉長的做法）大幅延長重試期。即使服務發生短暫波動，也不會隨意中斷你的工作階段。
body.en: When asking AI to perform long multi-step tasks, the biggest worry is hitting brief congestion on remote model servers. ⟦Much like a card reader briefly disconnecting at a busy bakery checkout, where the clerk does not immediately return your items and show you out the door, but asks you to wait a moment and tap again until the connection recovers.⟧ Previously, whenever encountering a transient model API error like `503 Unavailable`, the entire ongoing session was forced to terminate. Now, when encountering such temporary situations, the agent significantly extends the retry period using exponential backoff (waiting longer between retries as failed attempts increase). Even during brief service fluctuations, your session will no longer be casually interrupted.

items.original: Improved resilience to transient model API errors: the agent now retries errors such as `503 Unavailable` for much longer with exponential backoff, so a brief service hiccup no longer aborts your session.

title.zh-TW: 本機憑證快讀登入身分，切換帳號清空企業舊資料
title.en: Local credentials speed up sign-in identity checks and account switching clears stale business data

body.zh-TW: 每次啟動工具或切換帳號，現在都能迅速就緒。以前每次開啟命令列或在瀏覽器完成授權，都要先送出一趟網路請求確認身分；若是查詢遇到問題，整個登入程序就會卡住中斷，啟動時顯示的方案等級也常常閃爍消失。現在改為直接從儲存的憑證（存放在本機的登入身分證明）讀取資料，查詢失敗不再阻礙登入完成，畫面上的方案等級更維持穩定顯示。若是你剛從選定專案的企業帳號切換至個人帳號，舊的企業專案與授權細節現在會被徹底清除，不再因為殘留過期資料而跳出專案存取錯誤。⟦這好比拿出皮夾裡已蓋章的會員卡直接通關，驗票員不必每次都打電話回總部查驗，換成一般訪客卡時也會順手收回貴賓通行證，不再拿舊通行條擋住入口。⟧
body.en: Launching the tool or switching accounts is now ready promptly every time. Previously, opening the CLI or completing browser authorization required sending a network request to verify your identity; if the lookup ran into issues, the entire sign-in process would freeze and halt, and the plan tier shown at startup often flickered and disappeared. Now, data is read directly from stored credentials (login identity proofs stored locally), so lookup failures no longer block sign-in completion, and the on-screen plan tier remains stably displayed. If you switch from a business account with a selected project to a personal account, old business project and license details are now thoroughly cleared, preventing project access errors caused by leftover stale data. ⟦This is like showing a stamped membership card directly from your wallet at the gate without ticket staff calling headquarters every time, and handing over a regular visitor pass while returning the VIP badge so outdated passes will not block the entrance.⟧

items.original:
Improved sign-in and startup speed by reading your signed-in identity from the stored credential instead of making a network request on every launch and after browser consent; a failed identity lookup no longer prevents sign-in from completing, and the displayed plan tier no longer briefly disappears during startup.
Fixed sign-in failing with a project access error after switching from a business account with a selected project to a personal account; stale business project and license details are now fully cleared on personal sign-in.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式自動化更順暢，及時退出且日誌回報清晰
title.en: Smoother headless automation with prompt exits and clear error reporting

body.zh-TW: 將指令串進自動化排程時，最講求乾淨俐落與明確回報。⟦宛如快遞物流車隊的夜間集運，貨件裝車完畢就立即發車，沿途留下明確標籤與簽收單，不因無人簽名而原地乾等。⟧ 啟用無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的非互動執行模式）搭配 `-p` 旗標時，現在送達最終答案便會迅速退出。背景任務與排程計時器受 `--print-timeout` 限制等待結束，但開發伺服器等常駐守護工作會持續運行而不被強制中止。每輪執行省下多達 200 ms 閒置延遲，並跳過生成無人查看的對話標題。遇到無人互動的實作計畫審查時會自動通過。若 `--print-timeout` 中途逾時，會回傳既有輸出並在 stderr 附帶警告成功退出，手動按 Ctrl+C 中斷則維持非零退出碼。嚴重錯誤在 stderr 加上穩定的 `error:` 標記，提示潛在截斷並解釋先前靜默結束的原因。
body.en: Chaining commands into automated workflows demands clean execution and explicit feedback. ⟦Much like a logistics delivery fleet consolidating cargo overnight, departing immediately once loading is complete and leaving clear labels and receipts along the way without idling on-site because no one is there to sign.⟧ When running in headless mode with the `-p` flag, the CLI now exits promptly once the final answer is delivered. Running background tasks and scheduled timers are waited on subject to `--print-timeout`, while persistent daemon tasks like development servers continue running without being forcefully terminated. Each turn cuts up to 200 ms of idle latency and skips generating conversation titles that nobody would see. Non-interactive implementation plan reviews now pass automatically. If `--print-timeout` expires mid-turn, it returns the partial output and exits successfully with a warning on stderr, while manual Ctrl+C interrupts still exit with a non-zero code. Fatal errors add a stable `error:` marker on stderr, noting potential truncation and explaining why previous runs ended silently.
